dict.items.md:
**Python Dictionary items() Method**

The items() method returns a view object. The view object contains the key-value pairs of the dictionary, as tuples in a list.

**Syntax**

`dictionary.items()`

**Example**

```python
car = {  "brand": "Ford",  "model": "Mustang",  
    "year": 1964}x = car.items()print(x)
```

Source: https://www.w3schools.com/python/ref_dictionary_items.asp

dict.copy.title: Python Dictionary  copy() Method
dict.copy.md:
**Python Dictionary  copy() Method**

The copy() method returns a copy of the specified dictionary.

**Syntax**

`dictionary.copy()`

**Example**

```python
car = {  "brand": "Ford",  "model": "Mustang",  
    "year": 1964}
    x = car.copy()print(x)
```

Source: https://www.w3schools.com/python/ref_dictionary_copy.asp

dict.fromkeys.md:
**Python Dictionary fromkeys() Method**

The fromkeys() method returns a dictionary with the specified keys and the specified value.

**Syntax**

`dict.fromkeys(keys, value)`

**Example**

```python
x = ('key1', 'key2', 'key3')y = 0thisdict = dict.fromkeys(x, y)
    print(thisdict)
```

Source: https://www.w3schools.com/python/ref_dictionary_fromkeys.asp
